answer_1.quote: We propose a learner-like agent which mimics human learning behavior to enable the ability to select good example sentences.

answer_2.quote: The average accuracy of EMLA and CMLA is 0.90 and 0.86, while that excluding perturbing instances is 0.80 and 0.86, respectively.

answer_4.quote: We conducted a user study to see the effect of learning on example sentences selected by EMLA, CMLA, and a random baseline. In this learner study, a total of 29 Chinese-speaking college freshmen majored in English were recruited.
answer_4.guideline: Students were asked to answer the same question sets in the post-test so we can measure the improvement they made between the pre-test and the post-test.
